mathematical_semantics: two layers: a typed compatibility complex (A,W,P) of atoms, witnessed pairwise statuses and admissible paths, which is provably NOT a lattice; and a closure layer where only a declared extensive/monotone/idempotent operator cl yields the complete lattice of closed states with meet=intersection and join=cl(union)
pairwise compatibility does not imply a global section (three-context parity obstruction); gluing verdicts require obstruction objects on covers larger than pairs

failure_signatures: failure:RECONSTRUCT.GLUE.v0:pairwise-pass-global-fail — all pairwise overlaps compatible while no global assignment exists
falsifiers: the three-context parity obstruction (x XOR y=0, y XOR z=0, x XOR z=1): an implementation answering GLUED on the triple cover while the three pairwise checks pass is refuted
